status: exact finite algebra and one-loop witnesses; nonperturbative bridge remains unproved

compact.group: Spin(5) isomorphic to compact Sp(2), also written USp(4)
compact.euclideanYangMillsRole: a compact simple gauge group admitted by the Jaffe-Witten problem

split.gravityRole: the noncompact anti-de Sitter/Cartan spacetime gauge group used by the programme

pureYangMillsOneLoop.warning: equality of a perturbative ultraviolet coefficient does not identify the theories or prove either infrared mass gap

internalChain.route: E6 -> Spin(10) x U(1)_psi -> Standard Model gauge group -> SU(3)_color
internalChain.distinction: branching identifies possible fields and charges; it supplies neither the Yang-Mills measure nor confinement, a glueball spectrum, or a mass-gap proof

joinedResearchLadder: define compact Spin(5) lattice and continuum observables with a positive Euclidean measure
separate finite-volume transfer-matrix gaps from a uniform infinite-volume and continuum mass gap
derive the E6-to-Spin(10)-to-Standard-Model breaking spectrum, thresholds, anomalies and running couplings
treat SU(3)_color confinement and its gauge-invariant spectrum as an independent nonperturbative problem
define the broken Lorentzian Spin(2,3) Cartan theory and prove BRST/unitarity while retaining a massless spin-2 pole
test whether non-Einstein connection sectors are gapped without transferring a compact-theory gap by analytic continuation
rejoin the arms only through an explicitly derived shared scale, matching condition or protected observable

decision.reason: ordinary long-range gravity requires a massless spin-2 sector; only additional sectors may consistently be candidates for a gap
